component.name: AdmitPress
component.summary: Design and print sequential admission tickets

description.p: AdmitPress designs admission tickets and prints them in order, so every ticket that leaves the printer carries the next number in the sequence.

ul.li: A drag and drop layout editor for text, images, prices, dates and ticket numbers
Several prices per ticket, each with its own daily counter
Group sales that print or record many tickets at once under one name
Sales in a second currency, converted with exchange rates fetched online
A day and month sales overview that exports to spreadsheets
Printing through CUPS, or preview only while you set the layout up
Automatic backups of the database and the ticket artwork every three hours
